name: 非凡夕阳MUD
english_description: Part of the "Roaming Swordsman" engine lineage, though its own login banner instead reads "Extraordinary Young Master: Legend of the New Moon II." Despite the differing names, its map and key scenes are byte-identical to several sibling archives in this project, confirming it belongs to a shared family built on Jin Yong's sect and map world (Huashan, Wudang, Emei, Beggars' Sect, Ming Cult, Tianlong Temple, and more). Uniquely requires clients to send an exact version-handshake string before login proceeds, and needed no mudlib code changes at all to run under WASM.
